description: A white plastic interlocking piece sits on the bed in front of a pink pillow, with a few loose white parts nearby. The left hand stays planted on the left side to steady the main piece as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches in from the right as a right-hand object, presses and wiggles a top segment, then pulls a small piece free and moves it down and away, leaving the main piece supported by the left hand.
